t: This is Dorset Street, in Marylebone. It's named after John Sackville, the third Duke of Dorset, who lived from 1745 to 1799. He was a courtier and diplomat who inherited the dukedom in 1769 on the death of his uncle. From 1784 he served as British Ambassador to France, and he returned to England in August 1789 as the French Revolution escalated.
